card.name: Until and duration of after pausing
card.fires_on: The word "until" after a temporary stop or hold of a drug, and "of" in "for the duration of" or "length of" a treatment or infusion. It marks how long a temporary change lasts.

modes.label: Until after hold
modes.description: "until" following discontinue, interrupt or reduce, introducing the condition that ends the pause.
modes.example: administration of milrinone should be reduced or temporarily discontinued<< until>> the patient’s condition stabilizes.

modes.label: Duration of
modes.description: "of" after "the duration" or "the length", naming the period a temporary measure applies.
modes.example: interrupt CAMZYOS for the duration<< of>> treatment with a weak inhibitor of CYP

card.writes: It favors words about temporary or limited-time states, such as temporary and short-term.
card.plain: It spots wording that says a drug is held or changed only for a limited time, such as until a reaction clears or for the duration of treatment.
